title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Bartolome and Manuela Pañares Quốc gia tại Barangay Poblacion, Đô thị Barili, Tỉnh Cebu, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Bartolome and Manuela Pañares แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Poblacion เทศบาล Barili จังหวัด Cebu และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: The Bartolome and Manuela Pañares Memorial National High School in Barangay Poblacion, Municipality of Barili, Province of Cebu is hereby established.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations that would carry out the provisions of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and therefor.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
